summary: Elide builtin String.prototype.valueOf on a proven primitive string.

target.notes: For a proven primitive string with the builtin method intact, the result is exactly the same primitive string; no allocation or culture operation is needed.

caveats: Do not apply to borrowed calls on non-String receivers or boxed String runtime objects without proving equivalent internal [[StringData]] semantics.

tests.name: non generic caveat
tests.expected_behavior: throws TypeError; this test is outside the native fast-path requirements
